{
  "name": "deadlock_free",
  "description": "Tiny model where time can always pass; A[] not deadlock should be satisfied.",
  "category": "generic",
  "model_xml": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE nta PUBLIC "-//Uppaal Team//DTD Flat System 1.6//EN" "http://www.it.uu.se/research/group/darts/uppaal/flat-1_6.dtd">
<nta>
  <declaration>
// Global declarations.
  </declaration>
  <template>
    <name>IdleProcess</name>
    <location id="id0" x="0" y="0">
      <name x="-20" y="-30">Idle</name>
    </location>
    <init ref="id0"/>
    <transition>
      <source ref="id0"/>
      <target ref="id0"/>
    </transition>
  </template>
  <system>
P = IdleProcess();
system P;
  </system>
</nta>
",
  "queries": "A[] not deadlock
E<> P.Idle
"
}
